description: Store a file and get a URL for it — a report, a CSV, a transcript

content.description: The file's contents — plain text, or base64 when encoding is "base64"

encoding.description: "base64" for binary files; omit for text

name.description: File name including its extension, e.g. "report.csv"

type.description: Optional content type, e.g. "text/csv". Guessed from the name when omitted

name: files_put
title: Store files
